title: Create landing page for making money online with CTA buttons

requirements.summary: Create landing page with 5-6 CTA buttons linking to external blog
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays 5-6 distinct CTA buttons
All CTA buttons link to https://globalnewsdesk727.blogspot.com
Page theme clearly relates to making money online

file_operations.description: Create the main landing page component featuring 5-6 prominent CTA buttons with 'make money online' theme. Each button links to https://globalnewsdesk727.blogspot.com. Include hero section with generated hero-background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-background.dim_1920x1080.png) and integrate earning-icon (frontend/public/assets/generated/earning-icon.dim_256x256.png) for visual emphasis. Structure includes hero, benefits/features section with CTAs, and footer.

Wire the LandingPage component as the main route. Replace existing routing or default content to render LandingPage at the root path ('/'), ensuring users land directly on the money-making themed page.

Create a reusable CTA button component that accepts text, icon, and external link props. Style with Tailwind and shadcn/ui Button primitives to match the overall design theme (avoiding blue and purple). Include hover effects and accessibility attributes.

requirements.summary: Add contact button with appropriate styling and placement
acceptanceCriteria: Contact button is visible and accessible on the landing page
Contact button styling matches the overall design theme

file_operations.description: Add a contact button in a prominent location (e.g., header navigation or footer section). Style consistently with the CTA buttons but distinguish it as a secondary action. Link to a contact section or prepare for future contact form integration.

requirements.summary: Design landing page with creative, professional theme avoiding blue and purple
acceptanceCriteria: Visual design is cohesive and professional
Color scheme avoids blue and purple
Typography and layout create a polished appearance

file_operations.description: Define global CSS variables and base styles for the 'make money online' theme. Use warm tones (e.g., orange, gold, green, or neutral shades) and avoid blue and purple. Set typography scale, spacing, and ensure consistency across the application.

Customize Tailwind theme with a color palette that avoids blue and purple. Define primary, secondary, and accent colors in warm or neutral tones. Configure fonts, spacing, and extend theme for professional, cohesive design.
